rule.scope: Apply uniformly to every fold2 security.
rule.trigger: Any in-range Tencent hfq row is nonfinite, has nonpositive OHLC, violates OHLC ordering, has negative volume, is malformed, or duplicates a date.
rule.action: Quarantine the entire security snapshot as SOURCE_INVALID_ZERO_ROWS.
rule.downstream: The security remains in the frozen manifest but contributes no source rows. Frozen minimum-information rules decide evaluability.

reason: A full-security fail-closed quarantine avoids fabricated prices, cross-gap returns and post-observation vendor selection.
